label: Every being contingent at w has a distinct CAUSE_2 of its esse that itself exists at w
paraphrase: Conditional same-world strengthening of B2: for every bearer existing at the selected world and absent at an accessible world, there exists a numerically different bearer that itself exists at this selected world and causes that target's esse in the shared CausalityFrame. No identification of a receiving principle with this causal bearer, no temporal concurrency, no efficient-cause or grounding identification, and no claim that the first unmoved mover is the giver. The cause-presence bridge is independent and OPEN; absent sources can satisfy world-free CausesIn in structural interpretations.
